Cycles

Source: R/combinatorics-permgroups.R
Cycle.Rd

Cycle(...) is SymPy's Cycle: Cycle(1, 2) (or Cycle(c(1, 2))) maps 1 to 2 and 2 to 1. cycle_mul(c, ...) is SymPy's call c(...): the product of c and the cycle given by ..., applying c first, so cycle_mul(Cycle(1, 2), 2, 3) is SymPy's Cycle(1, 2)(2, 3). cycle_as_list() is SymPy's Cycle.list() and cycle_size() its size. A Cycle converts to a permutation with Permutation().

Usage

Cycle(...)

cycle_mul(c, ...)

cycle_size(c)

cycle_as_list(c, size = NULL)

Arguments

...

Integers of one cycle, a Cycle or a Permutation.

c

A Cycle.

size

Optional size of the list.

Value

A Cycle, an integer vector or an integer.

Examples

Cycle(1, 2)
#> (1 2)
cycle_mul(Cycle(1, 2), 2, 3)
#> (1 3 2)
cycle_as_list(Cycle(1, 2), 4)
#> [1] 0 2 1 3
